title: JDY-31A V2.241 (SPP + BLE)
notes: JDY-31A V2.241: confirmed five AT UART reads, name write/readback, operator-tested BAUD and PIN changes. Physical factory reset AT+DEFAULT restored JDY-33-SPP / BAUD=4 (9600) / PIN=1234; earlier JDY-31 was a MANUALLY chosen name, never factory. AT+RESET is a documented software restart, not a factory restore; its V2.241 behavior requires independent verification. Both operations are version-gated and separately confirmed. BLE GATT not managed in this UART tab.

edit.hint: Physically verified on JDY-31A V2.241: AT+NAME{value} returned +OK and matched UART readback (15 Oct 2026). Persistence across power-cycle not yet tested. Re-pairing may be required.
Changes UART baud index (4..9) for the next session. Confirm before sending: after power-cycle, change the PC COM baud to the selected rate; immediate readback may be unavailable.
Changes the SPP pairing PIN, exactly four decimal digits. Re-pair bonded devices if needed. Values must not be published.

factory_reset.evidence: 2026-10-15: operator issued AT+DEFAULT (+OK); after reset readback at 9600: +NAME=JDY-33-SPP, +BAUD=4, +PIN=1234. This is a result for this firmware/physical unit, not a model name change.

soft_reset.notes: Documented software reboot; expected to preserve settings. +OK reply/retention on this exact firmware not yet independently confirmed.
